account.id.withStaffDetail: Two members of SeeBuyGet staff look at the photographs and decide. Nothing changes until they have.
account.id.yoursRegister: Register again with the same phone number and your ID number: it goes through now.
account.id.yoursKept: Nothing about your registration has changed.
account.id.notYours: Staff decided the ID is not yours to register with
account.id.gone: The national ID on your {what} went to the other person
account.id.corrected: Your registration has an ID number of its own on record, so it is not held. Nothing else has changed.
account.id.appointment.yoursDetail: Two members of staff decide again on what they see in person, and that decision is final. Your ticket is below.
account.id.appointment.theirs: The decision is being looked at again, in person
account.id.appointment.theirsDetail: The other person does not accept it and is coming in. You may come too, with your card, so that yours is looked at as well. Your ticket is below.
account.id.recheckedDetail: A member of staff has recorded what was seen at the appointment. A second one has to approve it.
account.id.conceded.claimant: The person who held your number said it was not theirs, and has put their own on record.
account.id.conceded.holder: Your own ID number is on record
account.id.conceded.holderDetail: You said the number on your registration was not yours and put the right one there. Nothing else has changed.
account.id.lapsed.claimant: No photographs were sent in time, so nothing went to staff and the other person was never told. You can dispute it again.
account.id.chooseDay: Still disputed? Choose a day to come in
account.id.chooseDayHint: You are given a ticket: where to go, when, and what to bring.
account.id.chooseDayFrom: The office receives visitors on: {when}. Choose one of its days in the next three weeks.
account.id.chooseDayNoDays: The office for your country has not said which days it receives visitors. Choose a day from tomorrow, within three weeks, and ask SeeBuyGet staff before you travel.
account.id.chooseHour: Then choose the hour you will come. Each lasts an hour, and only so many people are seen in one.
account.id.noDayFree: No day is free in the next three weeks
account.id.noDayFreeDetail: Every hour the office receives visitors is taken, or it is closed. Look again tomorrow, or speak to SeeBuyGet staff with your reference.
account.id.changeDayHint: You can change it {n, plural, one {once more} other {# more times}}, before the day comes.
account.id.ticket.title: Your ticket
account.id.ticket.noPlace: The SeeBuyGet office for your country. Its address is not written down here yet: ask SeeBuyGet staff where to go before you travel.
account.id.ticket.noAddress: Its address is not written down here yet: ask SeeBuyGet staff where to go before you travel.
account.id.ticket.noDays: It has not said which days it receives visitors: ask before you travel.
account.id.ticket.offDay: The office no longer receives visitors then
account.id.ticket.offDayYours: It changed its days, its hours or its closed dates after you chose. Choose again, below.
account.id.ticket.offDayTheirs: It changed its days, its hours or its closed dates after this was chosen. The other person has been asked to choose again; look here again before you travel.
account.id.ticket.willRemind: We remind you the day before, here and by email: when, where and what to bring.
account.id.ticket.reminded: A reminder went to you on {when}.
account.id.ticket.cannotRemind: We cannot remind you: you have no SeeBuyGet account for a reminder to reach. Write the day down, and what to bring.
account.id.ticket.noShow: If you cannot come, change the day before it comes. If you do not come, the decision stands.
account.id.ticket.mayCome: You do not have to come. If you do not, staff decide on what the other person shows them.
account.id.bring.id_card: Your ID card itself. Not a copy, not a photograph
account.id.bring.phone: The phone you use with SeeBuyGet
account.id.bring.second.driver: A second document in your name, if you have one: your driving licence
account.id.bring.second.shop: A second document in your name, if you have one: your trading licence
account.id.own.open: The number on my record was mistyped: put it right
account.id.own.openHeld: Put the number of my own ID card on record
account.id.own.label: The number on your own ID card
account.id.own.hint: This ends the dispute at once. Your registration takes this number, the other person can register with theirs, and nothing else changes for you.
account.id.own.hintHeld: Once your own number is on record your registration is no longer held.
account.id.own.cta: Put this number on my record
account.id.own.signIn: If the number on your record was simply mistyped, sign in and open Settings: you can put the right one there, and that ends this at once.
account.settings.id.title: Somebody says the national ID on your registration is theirs
account.settings.id.detailBy: Answer by {date}: show your own ID card, or put right a number that was mistyped. If you do nothing, the ID goes to them and your registration is held.
account.settings.id.detail: Two members of SeeBuyGet staff are deciding whose it is. Open it to see where it stands.
account.settings.id.decidedTitle: A decision was made about the national ID on your registration
account.settings.id.decidedDetail: Two members of SeeBuyGet staff decided whose it is. Open it to read what they decided, and what you can still do.
account.settings.id.heldDetail: The national ID it was registered with went to somebody else. You finish what you have in hand and start nothing new until the number of your own ID card is on record.
account.settings.id.openHeld: Put my own ID number on record
account.settings.emailBouncedSub: {email} — email to it is coming back
account.settings.emailBounced.title: Email to your recovery address is coming back
account.settings.emailBounced.detail: We could not deliver to {email}, so we have stopped writing to it. It is how we reach you if you lose your phone. Check it, or put another address in its place: tap Recovery email.
account.settings.emailBounced.how: To keep the same address, enter it here, send the code, and type in the code you receive: that proves it works again. Or enter another address.
account.settings.phoneSub: Move your account to a new number
account.shopDevices.sub: The phones the {party}’s sign-in works on
account.shopDevices.none: The {party}’s sign-in works on no phone at the moment. The next sign-in asks for a code to the {party}’s number first.
account.shopDevices.one: The {party}’s sign-in works on one phone or browser.
account.shopDevices.many: The {party}’s sign-in works on {n} phones and browsers.
account.shopDevices.how: Each was confirmed once, by a code sent to the {party}’s number and typed on it. One that is not used for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} stops working until it is confirmed again.
account.shopDevices.forgetOthersBody: Every other phone stops working for the {party} until a code to the {party}’s number is typed on it, and anybody signed in there is signed out. This phone stays the {party}’s; you sign in again here.
account.shopDevices.forgetThisBody: This phone stops working for the {party}: signing in here will ask for a code to the {party}’s number. For a phone the {party} lent, sold or lost.
account.bound.title: Confirm this phone or browser
account.bound.lede: This phone or browser has not signed in to the {party} before. A code went to the {party}’s number ending {sentTo}.
account.bound.code: The 6-digit code from the text message
account.bound.why: The {party}’s sign-in works only on the {party}’s own phones and browsers, so a password that is passed round does not open it anywhere else.
account.bound.needsPhoneLede: The password is right. The {party}’s sign-in now works only on its own phones and browsers, and each new one is confirmed by a code to the {party}’s number. This {party} has no number yet: give the number of a phone the {party} keeps. The code goes to it.
account.phoneVerify.send: Send a code to this number
account.ways.appHint: Only if {app} is on this number. If it does not arrive within a minute, it comes by text.
account.ways.wait: Didn’t get it? In {s} seconds you can ask another way.
account.ways.ready: Didn’t get it? Ask another way:
account.ways.sentBy: Your code was sent by {app}: look in your {app} chats.
account.ways.never: Nobody from SeeBuyGet will ever ask you for this code.
account.truecaller.hint: Truecaller on this phone confirms the number it holds. We read only that number.
account.truecaller.instead: Send a code by text instead
account.truecaller.confirmed: Your number is confirmed by Truecaller.
account.truecaller.notInstalled: Truecaller is not on this phone, so your code came by text.
account.truecaller.declined: Not confirmed in Truecaller, so your code came by text.
account.truecaller.otherNumber: Truecaller on this phone holds another number, so your code came by text to the number you typed.
account.truecaller.failed: Truecaller did not confirm your number, so your code came by text.
account.passkeyOffer.title: Sign in with your fingerprint or face next time?
account.passkeyOffer.body: Your phone checks it, and nothing of it reaches us. Your PIN keeps working, and you can turn this off in Settings.
account.passkeyOffer.done: Done: next time, your fingerprint or face signs you in on this phone.
account.passkeyOffer.cancelled: Your phone did not finish it. Try again, or turn it on later in Settings.
account.phoneVerify.why: The store’s sign-in works only on its own phones and browsers: each new one is confirmed by a code to this number. So it is checked now, by a code.
common.needsSignal.signInDetail: SeeBuyGet checks who is signing in, so it waits for a signal. What was kept on this phone before still goes when there is one.
account.payout.title: Payout number
account.payout.subNone: Not set — nothing is paid until it is
account.payout.body: Your payouts go by M-Pesa to this number. A code is texted to it, to show it is yours.
account.payout.change: After a change, nothing is paid for 24 hours, and your old number is texted that it was replaced. That gives you time to stop somebody who took your account.
account.payout.savedHeld: Nothing is paid to it before {when}.
account.payout.oldTexted: Your old number was texted that it was replaced.
account.payout.oldKept: Test mode: the text to your old number was kept, not sent.
account.payout.oldNotSent: Your old number could not be texted.
account.payout.bodyPartner: {partner} pays you to this number, by phone, for your work for it. A code is texted to it, to show it is yours.
account.payout.numberLabelPartner: Phone number, with its country code
partner.owed.totalPaid: {partner} has paid you {paid}, and owes you {open} more
partner.owed.allPaid: {partner} has paid you all it owes: {paid}
partner.owed.daily: It pays once a day, to the payout number you set in Settings. With no number set, your payout waits for one.
account.mollie.title: Mollie
account.mollie.subTestKey: Connected for testing: no real money
account.mollie.subChecking: {name} · Mollie is still checking the account
account.mollie.subFleet: The company you drive for is paid for your work: its office connects Mollie.
account.mollie.body: Connect your own Mollie account, and a shipper who pays you directly can pay at the handover, by iDEAL or card, from a QR code on your phone. The money goes into your Mollie account, never through SeeBuyGet. Mollie tells us when it is paid, and the load says so.
account.mollie.fee: SeeBuyGet takes a small fee for server costs from each payment, through Mollie. You see it before you ask for a payment, and get one invoice a month for it.
account.mollie.testKeyBody: Payments go to SeeBuyGet’s own test account, in test money. Nothing real is paid.
account.mollie.testPayments: For now these are test payments: no real money.
account.mollie.checkingTitle: Mollie is still checking your account
account.mollie.checkingBody: Payments can be taken once Mollie has finished. Mollie tells you what it still needs.
account.mollie.lostBody: The access was ended in your Mollie account. Connect again to take payments at the handover.
account.mollie.backExpired: That took too long: connect again.
account.mollie.backDenied: You did not give access in Mollie, so nothing was connected.
account.mollie.backNoProfile: Your Mollie account has no profile to take payments with yet. Add one in Mollie, then connect again.
account.mollie.backFailed: Mollie could not be connected: try again.
account.mollie.invoicesNone: No invoice yet. One comes each month after a month with payments by Mollie.
partner.owed.title: What the partner owes you
partner.owed.note: In this country a partner company contracts and pays for the network: it pays you for these steps, at its own rates.
account.devices.title: Phones and browsers
account.devices.none: Your PIN does not work on any phone or browser at the moment. The next sign-in asks for a code to your number first.
account.devices.one: Your PIN works on one phone or browser.
account.devices.many: Your PIN works on {n} phones and browsers.
account.devices.how: Each was confirmed once, by a code sent to your number and typed on it. One that is not used for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} stops working until it is confirmed again.
account.devices.notHere: The phone or browser you are using now is not one of them.
account.devices.forgetOthersBody: Every other phone and browser will need a code to your number before your PIN works on it again. You are signed out everywhere, here too: sign back in here with your PIN.
account.devices.forgetOthersSave: Forget them, and sign me out
account.devices.forgetThis: Sign out, and forget this one
account.devices.forgetThisBody: For a phone or a computer that is not yours. You are signed out here, and your PIN does not work here again until a code to your number is typed on it. Your other phones stay as they are.
account.devices.forgetThisSave: Forget this one, and sign me out
account.devices.unread: This could not be read. Try again in a moment.
account.passkey.title: Unlock with fingerprint or face
account.passkey.subOn: On for this phone. Your PIN works too.
account.passkey.subOff: Off. You sign in with your PIN.
account.passkey.onBody: You sign in here with your fingerprint or face, the way you unlock this phone. Your PIN still works, here and on your other phones. Turned on {when}.
account.passkey.offBody: Sign in here with your fingerprint or face instead of typing your PIN — the way you unlock this phone. It works on this phone only, and your PIN keeps working everywhere.
account.passkey.privacy: Your fingerprint or face never leaves this phone. SeeBuyGet keeps only a key that proves it is this phone.
account.passkey.pinToTurnOn: Your PIN, to turn it on
account.passkey.nowBody: Tap the button. Your phone asks for your fingerprint or face, as it does to unlock it.
account.passkey.turnOff: Turn it off, use my PIN
account.passkey.turnedOn: Turned on. Next time, sign in with your fingerprint or face.
account.passkey.turnedOff: Turned off. Sign in with your PIN, as before.
account.passkey.cancelled: Your phone did not turn it on. Try again — or keep using your PIN.
account.passkey.unread: This could not be read. Try again in a moment.
account.unlock.cancelled: Your phone did not unlock. Tap to try again, or use your PIN.
account.unlock.failed: That did not go through. Tap to try again, or use your PIN.
account.unlock.offTitle: Fingerprint or face is off on this phone
account.unlock.offBody: Type your PIN. You can turn it on again under Settings.
account.passkey.subOnPassword: On for this phone. The password works too.
account.passkey.subOffPassword: Off. You sign in with the password.
account.passkey.onBodyPassword: The {party} signs in here with your fingerprint or face, the way you unlock this phone. The password still works, here and on the {party}’s other phones. Turned on {when}.
account.passkey.offBodyPassword: Sign the {party} in here with your fingerprint or face instead of typing its password — the way you unlock this phone. It works on this phone only, and the password keeps working everywhere.
account.passkey.turnOffPassword: Turn it off, use the password
account.passkey.turnedOffPassword: Turned off. Sign in with the password, as before.
account.passkey.cancelledPassword: Your phone did not turn it on. Try again — or keep using the password.
account.passkey.passwordToTurnOn: The {party}’s password, to turn it on
account.passkey.sharedTitle: Only on a phone that is yours alone
account.passkey.sharedBody: Whoever can unlock this phone — with a fingerprint, a face, or the phone’s own PIN or pattern — can then sign in as the {party} without the password.
account.unlock.cancelledPassword: Your phone did not unlock. Tap to try again, or use the password.
account.unlock.failedPassword: That did not go through. Tap to try again, or use the password.
account.unlock.offBodyPassword: Type the password. You can turn it on again under Settings.
account.passkey.subCounter: Off: colleagues sign in on this phone.
account.passkey.counterTitle: Not on a phone colleagues sign in on
account.passkey.counterBody: A colleague opened their own session on this phone ({when}), so a fingerprint or face cannot stand in for the {party}’s password here: whoever can unlock the phone could then sign in as the {party}.
account.passkey.counterElsewhere: It works on a phone that only you sign in on. Here, sign in with the password.
account.car.title: Messages in the car
account.car.subOff: Off. Turn it on to hear your messages in the car.
account.car.unread: Could not check this just now. Try again in a moment.
account.car.offBody: With your phone connected to Android Auto, the car reads aloud the messages from the people in your chats about loads, and you answer by voice. Offers, prices and settlements stay on the phone, for when you have stopped.
account.car.safety: The car reads your answer back before it is sent. It arrives as text, marked “Sent from the car”, so the other side knows why it is short.
account.car.privacy: Google’s Firebase only tells this phone that a chat has news — never the words, and never who wrote them. The phone then fetches the message from SeeBuyGet.
account.car.pinToTurnOn: Your PIN, to turn it on
account.car.turnedOff: Turned off. The car no longer reads your messages.
account.car.waitingBody: The SeeBuyGet Driver app on this phone is taking its key. If nothing opened, tap “Open it on this phone”.
account.car.waitingAgain: The phone has not answered yet. If nothing opened, turn it off and on again.
account.car.oldBody: Reading messages aloud in the car works on phones with Android {min} or newer. This phone says it has Android {version}. Your messages still arrive in the app.
account.car.onBody: With this phone connected to Android Auto, your messages are read aloud in the car and you answer by voice. Your answer says “Sent from the car”.
account.contract.title: Who you contract with
account.contract.none: No company of ours contracts with you where you work.
account.contract.lede: You contract with {company}. These are the licences and insurance it trades on. Each number can be checked with whoever issued it.
account.contract.noPapers: {company} has no licence or insurance on its record.
account.contract.foot: If one of these is not right, say so and attach what shows it. Nothing changes by reporting: the paper keeps counting, the company is told what you said and not who said it, and SeeBuyGet staff decide.
account.contract.sent: It keeps counting while SeeBuyGet staff look. {company} is told what you said, not who said it. What they decide will be said here.
account.contract.yours.open: You reported this on {when}. SeeBuyGet staff are looking at it.
account.contract.yours.struck: You reported this, and it was struck: {reason}
account.contract.yours.dismissed: You reported this. It was looked at and stands: {reason}
account.contract.needNote: Say what is wrong with it.
account.contract.needEvidence: Attach what shows it: a screenshot or a photo.
account.contract.form.lede: Say what is wrong and attach what shows it, such as a screenshot of the issuer’s register.
account.contract.form.unreadable: That picture could not be read. Choose another.
account.contract.cat.expired: It has run out, or been withdrawn
account.contract.cat.not_genuine: It is not a genuine paper
account.contract.cat.wrong_details: The number or the date is not what the paper says
account.contract.cat.other: Something else is wrong with it
account.settings.phoneBody: Your account moves to the new number and keeps everything else, your PIN included. You are signed out everywhere and sign back in with the new number. For 24 hours the change can be undone.
account.settings.phoneParcels: Your parcels come with you. For seven days a parcel sent to your old number still reaches you, and nobody else can use that number here. In that week, give your new number to the people and the stores that send to you, then block the old one in Settings. After seven days it is let go.
account.settings.oldNumber.title: Your old number
account.settings.oldNumber.kept: A parcel sent to your old number still reaches you until {until}.
account.settings.oldNumber.notYet: Give your new number to the people and the stores that send to you. You can block the old number once the change can no longer be undone.
account.settings.oldNumber.blockWhenRead: Give your new number to the people and the stores that send to you. When they have it, block the old one. After {until} it is let go anyway.
account.settings.oldNumber.blockBody: From now on, a parcel sent to your old number will not reach you: it belongs to whoever has that number. Parcels that already reached you stay yours. This cannot be undone.
account.settings.oldNumber.blocked: It is no longer part of your account. A parcel sent to it will not reach you.
account.settings.phoneDone: Sign in with the new number and the same PIN. If this was a mistake, choose “Trouble signing in?” on the sign-in screen within 24 hours to undo it.
account.settings.pinToConfirm: Your PIN, to confirm it is you
account.settings.changed: Your phone number was changed on {when}. It can be undone until {until}.
account.safety.sendCode: Send a code to this address
account.safety.codeSent: Check your inbox. The code works for 15 minutes.
account.safety.sendPhoneCode: Send a code to this number
account.safety.phoneCodeLabel: The 6-digit code from the text message
account.safety.signupLede: One more step. If you ever lose this phone number, the email is how you get your account back — and we write to it when something changes on your account.
account.safety.resetLede: This phone or browser is new to your account. To replace your PIN here, type the recovery email on your account. We send it a code.
account.safety.resetCta: Replace my PIN and sign in
account.trouble.title: Trouble signing in?
account.trouble.lede: Forgot your PIN but still have your number? Close this and choose “Forgot your PIN?” — a code to your phone is all you need. These are for when that cannot work.
account.trouble.gone: I no longer have my number
account.trouble.goneSub: And I forgot my PIN — get back in with my email
account.trouble.undoSub: Somebody moved my account to another number
account.trouble.knowPinTitle: New number, and you know your PIN?
account.trouble.knowPin: Sign in with your old number and PIN — that still works from any phone — then open Settings and choose Phone number.
account.trouble.goneDone: Your account is on the new number. Close this and sign in with it and your new PIN.
account.trouble.undoDone: Your account is back on the old number, and the PIN is locked. Use the forgot-PIN link: a code goes to your number and you choose a new PIN.
account.trouble.goneLede: We send a code to the email on your account. Then tell us your new number, and choose a new PIN.
account.trouble.nationalIdHint: The one you registered with as a driver or a shop.
